description: Split CSV parsing into two distinct phases: Phase 1 (structural indexing) scans the entire input to build a complete structural index, and Phase 2 (field extraction) reads the index to extract and convert individual field values. This decouples I/O-bound scanning from compute-bound extraction.
mathematical_formalization: Phase 1: T_1 = N / BW_mem (memory bandwidth bound). Phase 2: T_2(c) = F_c * C_extract per column, parallelizable. Total: T = T_1 + T_2. Amdahl: speedup = (T_1 + T_2_serial) / (T_1 + T_2_serial / C_threads).
analogical_connections: simdjson Stage 1 + Stage 2: structural index then DOM construction
Compiler front-end/back-end split: lexing -> AST, code gen from AST
MapReduce: Map (scan/classify) then Reduce (aggregate into columns)
implementation_hypothesis: Phase 1: SIMD-scan in 64-byte chunks, produce Vec<u32> of field offsets and row offsets. Phase 2: for each column, iterate offsets with stride=column_count. Spawn one thread per column-group for parallel extraction.
experiment_seed: Measure Phase 1 vs. Phase 2 time on 10GB CSV with 20 columns. Test Phase 2 parallelism scaling 1-16 threads.
